title: KnowledgeSourceDescriptor
description: Descriptor for a Knowledge Source (KS). KSs are Pack-shipped sandboxed Java JARs. KSs are unaware of each other; ordering is data-driven via triggerPredicate over Blackboard state. No `dependsOn` between KSs. Wave 9: each KS targets exactly one Blackboard instance (`source` or `target`); Target-Blackboard KSs may declare `direction = TOP_DOWN` to allow `readsPanels` to include panels that are descendants (not ancestors) of `writesPanel` -- used for the granularity revision flow Statement -> Definition.Verdict.

family.description: Wave 9: dropped `EvidenceCollectionKS` (evidence is now an optional Contribution-level property attached by any KS); kept `GranularityKS` (now a TOP_DOWN Target-Blackboard KS writing Definition.Verdict from a Statement read); kept `ConfidenceSynthesisKS` (now a Statement-shaping KS posting refined Statement Contributions whose `confidence` reflects the synthesis -- folded by the `compose` resolver on Statement.Draft).

targetBlackboard.description: Which Blackboard instance this KS contributes to. `source` -> SourceBlackboard (Pack-owned panels); `target` -> TargetBlackboard (engine-owned panels Definition/Archetype/Statement). Source-Blackboard KSs run only during the Source phase (before SourceFreeze); Target-Blackboard KSs run only during the Target phase (after SourceFreeze) and access the frozen Source state via `controlContext.sourceFreeze()`.

direction.description: Direction of data flow relative to the panel DAG within this KS's target Blackboard. BOTTOM_UP (default): `readsPanels` MUST be a subset of the transitive ancestors of `writesPanel`. TOP_DOWN: `readsPanels` MAY include panels that are DESCENDANTS of `writesPanel` -- the engine accepts the inverted dependency as a revision flow. The only sanctioned TOP_DOWN family is `GranularityKS` (reads Statement, writes Definition.Verdict). Source-Blackboard KSs are always BOTTOM_UP.

writesPanel.description: Panel this KS writes to. Engine-owned Target panels: `Definition`, `Archetype`, `Statement`. Source panels: any Pack-namespaced name from a registered Pack manifest (e.g. `itip:SourceUnit`). The dropped Granularity/Evidence/Confidence panels (Wave 9) are no longer accepted.

writesSlots.description: Contribution-type names within writesPanel that this KS may post (subset of the keys of the panel's closed slots map).

readsPanels.description: Panels this KS reads. For BOTTOM_UP KSs (default): MUST be a subset of `dependsOnPanels*` of `writesPanel` in the panel DAG of this KS's target Blackboard. For TOP_DOWN KSs: MAY include descendants of `writesPanel`. Target-Blackboard KSs MAY also list source-panel names; the engine resolves them via the `SourceFreezeView` for read access.

triggerPredicate.description: Fully-qualified Java class name (loaded from the Pack JAR) implementing the engine's KsTriggerPredicate interface: `boolean test(BlackboardView view, SourcingRunContext ctx)`. Evaluated by the Sourcer Controller per scheduling tick. BlackboardView exposes typed Java accessors (resolved(panel, identity), contributionsOf(panel, identity), evidenceOf(identity), confidenceBelow(identity, threshold), statementAmbiguous(identity), validationFailed(identity), count(...), runContext().scope().includes(identity), ...) so triggers are expressed in plain Java. There is NO string DSL.

appliesToInterpretationKinds.description: Optional fast-pruning hint over slot names of read panels.

resolverHint.description: Recommended ContributionResolver for the writesPanel; RunConfig may override. `compose` = schema-driven per-key merging of value objects (engine merge function over the resolved JSON Schema); use it for panels whose value carries independent fields contributed by multiple KSs (e.g. Statement).

externalTools.description: Whitelisted external binaries this KS will execve via ControlContext.tool(name). Engine enforces: tool must be (a) declared here AND (b) bound in RunConfig.externalToolBindings.

budget.description: Per-tick budget caps. Engine enforces by cooperative cancellation at the next ControlContext call (.post / .resolved / .tool / .inference / .defman). On hard limit (e.g. wallClockMs reached during a blocking syscall), the engine cancels execve, drops the KS's pending posts in this tick, posts a Diagnostic, and re-enqueues the KS for the next tick (capped retries via RunConfig.ksBudgetOverrides).
